privacyPolicy.title: Política de privacidad
privacyPolicy.intro: SeasonPay es una app gratuita, en etapa piloto, para trabajadores de temporada. Aquí explicamos qué datos guarda, para qué y qué puedes hacer con ellos.

who.title: Quién está detrás
who.body: SeasonPay es un proyecto personal en piloto, sin empresa constituida todavía. Si eso cambia, lo actualizaremos aquí.

data.title: Qué datos guardamos
data.body:
En tu celular: tu perfil (tipo de visa, año de llegada, estado donde trabajas e idioma), tus empleadores y tarifa por hora, turnos, propinas, los montos de tus boletas, tu ahorro y las cotizaciones de envío que anotes.
Si creas una cuenta: tu nombre de usuario, tu contraseña cifrada (nadie puede leerla, ni nosotros) y una copia de esos mismos datos en nuestra base de datos (Supabase, servidores en EE. UU.) para respaldarlos y usarlos en otro celular.

never.title: Lo que nunca pedimos
never.body: SSN, ITIN, pasaporte, número de visa, cuentas bancarias ni tarjetas. Si algún día ves que la app te los pide, no es SeasonPay.

feedback.title: Comentarios y encuesta
feedback.body: Si envías un comentario o respondes la encuesta, guardamos lo que escribes, tu calificación, la versión de la app, el sistema del celular y la pantalla donde estabas. La captura de pantalla solo se envía si la activas, y es una imagen de la app, no de tu galería.

metrics.title: Métricas anónimas
metrics.body:
Registramos eventos de uso (por ejemplo "registró un turno" o "revisó una boleta") con un número aleatorio de tu celular. No incluyen tu usuario, tu nombre, montos ni texto que escribas.
Las usamos agregadas para mejorar la app, para un proyecto académico de análisis de datos y para mostrar resultados generales a terceros, como agencias de intercambio. Nunca se comparte información de una persona.
Puedes apagarlas en Ajustes → Privacidad.

push.title: Notificaciones
push.body: Si activas los recordatorios, guardamos la suscripción de tu navegador para avisarte fechas límite. Las puedes apagar cuando quieras.

purpose.title: Para qué los usamos
purpose.body: Para que la app funcione (calcular horas, overtime y ahorro), respaldar tus datos si tienes cuenta, responder a tus comentarios y mejorar la app con métricas agregadas.

sharing.title: No vendemos tus datos
sharing.body: No vendemos ni alquilamos tus datos personales. Solo los procesan los servicios que hacen funcionar la app (Supabase para la base de datos y Vercel para el sitio), y los entregaríamos a una autoridad solo si la ley lo exige.

rights.title: Tus datos son tuyos
rights.body:
Exportar: Ajustes → Exportar mis datos (JSON), o Temporada → Exportar resumen (PDF y CSV).
Borrar: Ajustes → Borrar mi cuenta y mis datos. Borra todo de este celular y, si tienes cuenta, la cuenta y sus datos del servidor, junto con los comentarios, encuestas, métricas y notificaciones enviados desde este celular.

transfer.title: Si el proyecto cambia de dueño
transfer.body: Si SeasonPay se vende, se fusiona o se transfiere, los datos pasarían al nuevo dueño, que deberá respetar esta misma política. Lo avisaremos en la app antes de que pase.

thirdParties.title: Sitios de terceros
thirdParties.body: La sección "Enviar plata" tiene links a proveedores de envío y casas de cambio. Al entrar a sus sitios aplican sus propias políticas.

tax.title: No es asesoría
tax.body: La información de impuestos y leyes laborales es informativa y enlaza a la fuente oficial. Confirma tu caso con tu empleador, tu sponsor o un profesional.

changes.title: Cambios a esta política
changes.body: Si la cambiamos, la app te mostrará la versión nueva y te pedirá aceptarla otra vez.

C.) puede correrla un día más. Te mostramos la fecha original para que no se te pase; confirma la definitiva en irs.gov o en la web de tu estado.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.intro: SeasonPay is a free app, in a pilot stage, for seasonal workers. Here we explain what data it keeps, why, and what you can do with it.

who.title: Who’s behind it
who.body: SeasonPay is a personal project in a pilot stage, with no company formed yet. If that changes, we’ll update it here.

data.title: What data we keep
data.body:
On your phone: your profile (visa type, arrival year, state where you work and language), your employers and hourly rate, shifts, tips, the amounts on your paystubs, your savings and any transfer quotes you write down.
If you create an account: your username, your encrypted password (nobody can read it, not even us) and a copy of that same data in our database (Supabase, servers in the US) to back it up and use it on another phone.

never.title: What we never ask for
never.body: SSN, ITIN, passport, visa number, bank accounts or cards. If the app ever asks you for them, it isn’t SeasonPay.

feedback.title: Feedback and survey
feedback.body: If you send feedback or answer the survey, we keep what you write, your rating, the app version, your phone’s system and the screen you were on. The screenshot is only sent if you turn it on, and it’s an image of the app, not from your photos.

metrics.title: Anonymous metrics
metrics.body:
We record usage events (for example "logged a shift" or "reviewed a paystub") with a random number for your phone. They don’t include your username, name, amounts or anything you type.
We use them in aggregate to improve the app, for an academic data analysis project and to show general results to third parties such as exchange agencies. Information about a single person is never shared.
You can turn them off in Settings → Privacy.

push.title: Notifications
push.body: If you turn on reminders, we keep your browser’s subscription to remind you of deadlines. You can turn them off anytime.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.body: To make the app work (hours, overtime and savings), back up your data if you have an account, reply to your feedback and improve the app with aggregate metrics.

sharing.title: We don’t sell your data
sharing.body: We don’t sell or rent your personal data. It’s only processed by the services that run the app (Supabase for the database and Vercel for the website), and we’d hand it to an authority only if the law requires it.

rights.title: Your data is yours
rights.body:
Export: Settings → Export my data (JSON), or Season → Export summary (PDF and CSV).
Delete: Settings → Delete my account and data. It deletes everything on this phone and, if you have an account, the account and its data on the server, along with the feedback, surveys, metrics and notifications sent from this phone.

transfer.title: If the project changes owners
transfer.body: If SeasonPay is sold, merged or transferred, the data would pass to the new owner, who must follow this same policy. We’ll tell you in the app before that happens.

thirdParties.title: Third-party sites
thirdParties.body: The "Send money" section links to transfer providers and exchange houses. Their own policies apply on their sites.

tax.title: Not advice
tax.body: Tax and labor information is informational and links to the official source. Confirm your case with your employer, your sponsor or a professional.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change it, the app will show you the new version and ask you to accept it again.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Write to us from Settings → Send feedback.

tax.disclaimerBody: Each rule links to its official source. Confirm your case with your employer, your sponsor or a professional.

deadlines.weekendNote: Per the IRS (Publication 519), if the date falls on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday, it moves to the next business day. A holiday like Emancipation Day (April 16, in Washington, D.C.) can push it one more day. We show the original date so you don’t miss it; confirm the final one on irs.gov or your state’s website.

stateOt.flsaExcluded: According to the DOL, {{state}} law doesn’t cover jobs already covered by federal law (FLSA). In practice the federal rule applies: over 40 h a week at 1.5x.
stateOt.noOvertime: According to the DOL, {{state}} has no overtime rule of its own. The federal rule applies: over 40 h a week at 1.5x.
stateOt.weekly: According to the DOL, {{state}} pays overtime after {{weekly}} h a week at 1.5x.
stateOt.dailyWeekly: Under {{state}} law, overtime is paid at 1.5x after {{daily}} h in a day or {{weekly}} h in a week.
stateOt.appliedDaily: SeasonPay calculates the {{daily}} h daily overtime automatically. You can change it in Settings → Employers.
stateOt.manualDaily: SeasonPay doesn’t apply it automatically because it depends on your pay. If it applies to you, set it in Settings → Employers → "Daily overtime after".
stateOt.federalNote: Federal law (FLSA, 40 h a week) also applies if your employer is covered. There are exceptions by type of business, such as seasonal recreation: confirm with your employer.

notes.ak_small_employers: It doesn’t apply to employers with 3 or fewer employees.
notes.ca_double_time: After {{dt}} h in a day, double time (2x) applies. SeasonPay doesn’t calculate double time yet; check your paystub if you work long days.
notes.ca_seventh_day: On the 7th consecutive workday of the week: the first 8 h at 1.5x and hours over 8 at double time. SeasonPay doesn’t calculate it yet.
notes.co_12_consecutive: Hours past 12 consecutive hours are also overtime even across midnight, and whichever rule pays more is used.
notes.nv_wage_condition: Overtime after 8 h a day only applies if you earn less than 1.5 times the Nevada minimum wage. If you earn more, only the 40 h weekly rule counts.
notes.ky_seventh_day: Kentucky also has an overtime rule for the 7th workday in a week.
notes.seasonal_recreation_weekly: In seasonal recreation businesses, state law requires overtime after {{seasonal}} h a week.
notes.ny_live_in_44: Residential (live-in) workers get overtime after 44 h a week.
notes.or_industries_10: Certain manufacturing, cannery and packing plants also owe overtime after 10 h a day.
notes.ri_sunday_holiday: In retail and some other businesses, Sundays and holidays are paid at 1.5x under separate laws.
notes.wa_comp_time: If you ask for compensating time off instead of premium pay, overtime isn’t paid.
notes.mt_student_48: Students at seasonal recreation areas with employer-provided lodging or meals: overtime after 48 h (see the notice above).

settings.shareText: I’m using SeasonPay to track my shifts, tips and paystubs this season. It’s free during the pilot:
settings.title: Settings
settings.noEmployers: You don’t have any employers yet
settings.sourcesBody: SeasonPay informs, it doesn’t advise. Each rule comes from an official source and shows when it was verified. Confirm your case with your employer, sponsor or a professional.
settings.privacyBody: Your data lives on this phone. We never ask for your SSN, passport, ITIN or bank details.
settings.deleteAllSub: On this phone and, if you have an account, on the server
settings.exportMineSub: Everything the app keeps about you, as JSON
settings.metricsSub: They help improve the app. No username, name or amounts.
settings.deleteBody: Your shifts, tips, paystubs, savings, employers and profile will be deleted from this phone. If you have an account, the account and its data on the server too, plus the feedback, surveys and metrics sent from this phone. This can’t be undone.
